experts.description: Turn a learning goal into small tasks and evidence, with user-controlled teaching preferences.

displayDescription.zh: 围绕学习者目标规划小步路径，通过概念解释和迁移练习发现认知缺口，将确认过的偏好变成可撤回策略。
displayDescription.en: Plan small learning steps, check conceptual gaps through transfer, and draft revocable strategies from confirmed preferences.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我把一个学习目标拆成今天能做的一步
quickPrompts.en: Turn my learning goal into one step for today

quickPrompts.zh: 听听我的解释，找出一处理解缺口
quickPrompts.en: Find one gap in my explanation

quickPrompts.zh: 把我确认的学习偏好整理成策略草稿
quickPrompts.en: Draft a strategy from my confirmed preferences

experts.description: Review exam answers through source evidence, distractor analysis, and targeted transfer practice.

displayDescription.zh: 从用户提供的题目和作答出发定位原文证据，拆解干扰项与推理断点，再用同考点练习核验迁移能力。
displayDescription.en: Use supplied questions and responses to locate evidence, diagnose distractors, and test transfer with a new practice item.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我从原文证据复盘这道错题
quickPrompts.en: Review this mistake using source evidence

quickPrompts.zh: 用一个词族带我练习词根词缀
quickPrompts.en: Practice morphology with one word family

quickPrompts.zh: 围绕我的薄弱考点出一题迁移练习
quickPrompts.en: Create a transfer exercise for my weak point

experts.description: Guide project learning through driving questions, roles, milestones, and reviewable artifacts.

displayDescription.zh: 将项目想法整理为驱动问题、角色分工和可核验里程碑，围绕真实成果提供提示，帮助团队持续复盘。
displayDescription.en: Turn ideas into driving questions, responsibilities, and evidence-based milestones, with guidance grounded in actual work.

quickPrompts.zh: 把我们的项目选题拆成第一个里程碑
quickPrompts.en: Turn our project idea into a first milestone

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我们明确分工和每个人的交付物
根据这份产物指出下一步验证任务
quickPrompts.en: Suggest the next validation task for this artifact

experts.description: Align learning objectives, activities, and evidence to support teacher-led formative assessment.

displayDescription.zh: 依据授权共享的学习产物对齐教学目标与评价量规，整理过程证据和教学调整建议，保留教师最终判断。
displayDescription.en: Align goals and rubrics with authorized learning artifacts, supporting teacher review and instructional adjustments.

quickPrompts.zh: 为这份学习产物生成可核验的过程评价草稿
帮我对齐教学目标、活动与评价任务
根据已观察的薄弱点调整下一节课
quickPrompts.en: Adjust the next lesson using observed gaps
